title: Literature Review: CD Algebras, U-Shape, and Cross-Domain Applications

key_findings.cd_in_plasma_physics: ZERO prior art. Our work is genuinely novel.
key_findings.u_shape_response: Undocumented as named phenomenon. Closest analog: holographic discord non-monotonicity (Mori 2025). Our synthetic result may be novel.
key_findings.non_associativity_breaks_bh_entropy: Vacaru 2024 (2410.03701): R-flux non-associativity modifies RN black hole entropy. Standard Bekenstein-Hawking fails. Modified Perelman variables required.
key_findings.sedenion_contribution_in_forecasting: Numerion 2025 (2510.03251): sedenions contribute 40% of output weight in time series. Removing them causes largest single-dimension degradation. But response is monotonic, not U-shaped.
key_findings.non_associativity_classification: Wilmot 2025 (2505.11747): 4 types of non-associativity in CD algebras. ZD occur in multiples of 84 in sedenions. Connects to our AVT and Moreno decomposition.
